verdict.rationale: Figma Make's docs say you can describe what you want in chat and Make builds a Payload-powered backend with database, file storage, authentication and an admin panel. That backend pairs with a generated frontend in Next.js code, and publishing deploys both to Figma's hosted infrastructure, which together covers prompt-to-working-full-stack-app. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the generated full-stack apps actually work end-to-end (community evidence only confirms React code generation).

support.subject: As a founder, I can describe an app in natural language and get a working full-stack application

citations.quote: Describe what you want to build in the chat, and Make can create a Payload-powered backend, including a database, file storage, authentication, and an admin panel.
Generate and design your frontend in Figma Make, then create a backend to manage your content.
Publishing deploys your app and its Payload backend to Figma’s hosted infrastructure.
The generated Payload and Next.js code is included in your Make project.
